detail: Measured on published image set 3e53d7bc5dbd72de73042b46e6174d316ef7a63d fn-host (production), small-preset store reopened, heap 1068 MB, 14 threads, anonymous bytes read from /proc/PID/smaps_rollup 2 s after LISTENING: --tls-limit 65536 anon 29,860 kB (RSS 125,272); 16384 anon 18,704 (RSS 114,280); 4096 anon 15,916 (RSS 111,792). Per-thread mappings in smaps show ~1.04 MB resident anon each. Evidence hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/EVIDENCE.txt, hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/tr.py. books/profile-limits.lisp:37 says the served world passed 16384 at LOAD (image build), and tools/build_native_host.sh:251-274 sets the launcher's limit; the saved core started and served at 16384 and 4096 in this measurement, but no test suite was run at those values. The fix is a runtime-launcher value (cut_release.sh / build_native_host.sh), not a book decision; before it lands, the native modules that load the world and the world-deps check must run at the lower value, filtered. Also read profile-limits :thread-runtime-mib 4 (accounting term, 35 threads) against the measured ~1 MB per thread.
title: launcher runs at --tls-limit 65536: each thread's thread-local storage costs 512 KiB anonymous RSS; 16384 saves 11.2 MB and 4096 saves 14.0 MB on the 14-thread owner
